Interdisciplinary Emphases
Graduate students at UCSB may choose to enhance their education with an optional interdisciplinary emphasis. Offered across multiple departments, these emphases allow you to explore a focused area of study that complements your major discipline.
After you begin your studies at UCSB, you may petition to enroll in any emphasis for which you are eligible (note that eligibility may be limited by major and/or degree objective). For a full list of available interdisciplinary emphases and the departments that offer them, visit the UCSB General Catalog.
